description: This file declares structures and functions related to 'resolve undo' operations in a version control system, likely Git. It defines a struct for undo information and functions for recording, reading, clearing, and unmerging resolve undo data.

methods.name: record_resolve_undo
methods.description: Records resolve undo information for a cache entry within the index.

methods.name: resolve_undo_write
methods.description: Serializes and writes resolve undo information to a string buffer.

methods.name: resolve_undo_read
methods.description: Reads and deserializes resolve undo information from a buffer.

methods.name: resolve_undo_clear_index
methods.description: Clears resolve undo data from the index.

methods.name: unmerge_index_entry
methods.description: Reverts a specific index entry to a previous state based on resolve undo info.

methods.name: unmerge_index
methods.description: Reverts the entire index based on provided pathspec and resolve undo information.
